title: Hearts Plus: Extra Hearts
description: This mod adds extra hearts that can be found in structure chests, permanently increasing your maximum health with a cap of 20 full hearts!
body:
# 💖 Hearts Plus

Hearts Plus adds extra hearts (max health increases) that can be found as rare loot in chests inside structures across your Minecraft world.

Explore dungeons, temples, and other generated structures to discover heart items hidden in loot tables, giving you a new way to progress through survival beyond armor and enchantments.

## 🧠 Survival Progression System

Each heart item acts as a permanent max health upgrade when consumed in singleplayer.

This creates a loot-based progression system, rewarding exploration and making structures more meaningful throughout your world.

## ⚔️ Multiplayer Gameplay

In singleplayer, hearts are permanent and cannot be lost
In multiplayer, hearts can be stolen when a player is eliminated

This introduces a more competitive and high-risk system in PvP environments.

⚠️ Multiplayer is supported, but balance may vary depending on server setup.

## 🧩 Loot & Discovery

Hearts spawn in structure chests
Approximately 18% chance per eligible chest
Designed to encourage exploration and structure looting

## ⚙️ Compatibility

Fabric Loader
Minecraft 1.21.11
Server-compatible (Fabric servers)

Future versions may be added depending on demand.

## 💡 Summary

Hearts Plus is a loot-based survival progression mod that lets you find extra hearts in chests, permanently increasing your max health and rewarding exploration throughout your world.
